entries.title: Move with keys of your own
entries.body: Command search and Keyboard settings now list Move left, down, up and right, Move to the start and end, Move up and down a page, and Cancel. Give them keys, such as Option with J and K, and they do what the arrows, Home, End, the page keys and Escape do: in the Tasks list, on the task board, in Settings, in command search and inside a card. New commands go to the part of the window on the left, right, above or below. A key may now hold Option alone, and Control-Tab can be a shortcut. None of these commands has a key until you give it one.

picture.alt: Keyboard settings filtered to the movement commands, recording Option-J for Move down, with a warning that the key will no longer type in text fields
